teacher.target_source: original weights before any optimizer step

protocol.training: One original-weight fit; original 4096 windows, two epochs, same Adam, shuffle, labels and waveform gains. Sum note-label BCE + original-note Bernoulli KL + original-onset Bernoulli KL, coefficients 1, probability clip 1e-7. Original teacher targets cached before updates, immutable and outside gradient graph. Epoch2 only.
protocol.data: All555 takes retained with their original intended labels: pass1 train200, pass2 calibration200, pass3 test155; all roles anchor every take before random mixtures. Source-disjoint intervals, same instrument/session; previously inspected evidence, not a new blind test.
protocol.onsets: Original onset probabilities are preservation targets, not acoustic onset labels. No new onset annotations.
protocol.evaluation: Original, saved prior BCE epoch2, and teacher epoch2 on all original train4096/calibration1024/test1024 windows. Keep probability drift, threshold crossings, full source-occurrence deltas, exact frames and false/silence output. Prior rejected model is comparator only.
protocol.advancement: Complete integrity; test recall gain >=5 percentage points against original; each role has no extra-note or silence-extra growth, no exact-frame loss, no newly missed occurrence, and each occurrence present/longest loss <=25ms AND <=5% of its own original value. Nominal frame 256/22050 seconds, no rounding up. Pass warrants continuous comparison only; failure closes exact setting.
protocol.strict_reference: Report original zero-occurrence-loss clause separately, without changing old verdicts.
protocol.representation: Train precision>=99%, calibration and test>=95%; recall>=80%, exact_set>=70% overall and separately for3/4/5 distinct pitches, silence extras0. Distinct pitch frames, not installed note/string matching.
protocol.limitations: Previously inspected same instrument/session, not new blind validation. Nominal distinct-pitch occupancy is not string assignment or delivered MIDI. No equal-pitch unison multiplicity, bends, acoustic re-pluck, backend/export, timing, DAW/device or live acceptance.
protocol.resource: One GitHub CPU job, process105min/job120min; pinned prior625.9MB artifact stays on worker; teacher and output arrays about2.2GB uncompressed retained remotely14days. Only compact report/log artifact collected locally.
